question: Pointing to a photograph, a woman said to a man, “She is the wife of the only son of your brother's grandfather.” How is the woman in the photograph related to the man?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e70b8fc59f55523cbd1c0dcb6157cdd0120d14d1918de4106bf11139640dba2e.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fdea28c6fbc8ce52219659e0c34457744f362405fd8008b3dda80f6a7f612c24.png] 

Clearly, the woman in the photograph is mother of the man.

Hence, ‘**Mother**’ is the correct answer
